tagline.zh: Material 的调色板原子:固定 HCT 的色相与色度,只沿 tone(= CIE L*)展开 13 档——Android 系统每个关键色都这样成列。
tagline.en: Material's palette atom: fix HCT hue and chroma, expand only along tone (= CIE L*) into 13 steps — how every key color in Android is built.

origin.zh: HCT 由 Google material-color-utilities 定义:Hue/Chroma 取自 CAM16 色彩外观模型,Tone 即 CIE L*(CAM16 × L*,并考虑观看条件)。调色板法定义是『固定色相与色度、仅 tone 变化的色列』;Android 系统为每个关键色生成 13 档 tone(调研 06§二5)。demo 内嵌该库 0.3.0(Apache-2.0)发布源码的 TS 简版移植,常量逐字对照。
origin.en: HCT was defined by Google's material-color-utilities: Hue/Chroma come from the CAM16 color appearance model, Tone is CIE L* (CAM16 × L*, with viewing conditions). A tonal palette is by definition 'a column of colors with fixed hue and chroma, varying only in tone'; Android generates 13 tones per key color (research 06 §5). The demo embeds a TS mini-port of the published 0.3.0 library (Apache-2.0) with constants copied verbatim.

effect.zh: CAM16 色相角 0–360°,调色板的『名字』。注意刻度与 hsl/oklch 都不同:oklch 蓝≈220°,而 HCT 蓝≈300°附近。默认 299 = M3 基线种子紫 #6750A4 的 HCT 色相(用本条目内嵌的 CAM16 前向模型实测 298.98;调研 06§六7 载明 #6750A4 为官方亮色 primary)。
effect.en: CAM16 hue angle 0–360° — the palette's identity. Its scale matches neither hsl nor oklch: oklch blue ≈ 220° while HCT blue sits near 300°. Default 299 = the HCT hue of the M3 baseline seed purple #6750A4 (measured 298.98 with this entry's embedded CAM16 forward model; research 06 §7 records #6750A4 as the official light primary).

effect.zh: CAM16 色度,0 = 无彩色灰,全列共用。默认 48 对齐 M3 基线 primary 调色板档位(#6750A4 实测 chroma≈47.9);material-color-utilities 求解器内部搜索上限为 200。某 tone 的高色度若超出 sRGB 可达范围,求解器按官方行为截断为该 tone 可达的最大色度——阶梯两端(近黑近白)会自然变灰。
effect.en: CAM16 chroma; 0 = neutral gray, shared by the whole column. Default 48 aligns with the M3 baseline primary palette level (#6750A4 measures chroma≈47.9); the material-color-utilities solver searches up to 200 internally. When a tone's requested chroma exceeds what sRGB can reach, the solver follows its official behavior and clamps to the maximum achievable — the ladder ends (near black/white) naturally desaturate.

effect.zh: 查看档位:Tone 即 CIE L*(0–100),tone 是唯一的自由度。默认 80 = M3 暗色 primary 所在档(官方基线暗色 primary #D0BCFF 实测 tone≈80,调研 06§六7)。库内约定(contrastLevel 0):亮色 accent 取 40/暗色取 80,container 取 90/30,on-色取 100/20——tone 即角色。13 档取值 0,10,…,90,95,99,100 为 Android 社区通行的 13-tone 集合,与调研 06§二5 记载的『每关键色 13 档』数量一致;95/99 两个亮端档的具体取值未在本次抓取的一手来源逐值核实。
effect.en: Tone to inspect: tone IS CIE L* (0–100) and the only degree of freedom. Default 80 = the step of the M3 dark primary (official baseline dark primary #D0BCFF measures tone≈80, research 06 §7). Library convention (contrastLevel 0): light accent takes 40 / dark takes 80, containers take 90/30, on-colors take 100/20 — tone is the role. The 13 values 0,10,…,90,95,99,100 follow the community-standard Android 13-tone set, consistent with the '13 tones per key color' count recorded in research 06 §5; the two bright-end values (95/99) were not individually verified against the fetched first-hand sources.

note.zh: HCT 是纯 JS/原生库算法(material-color-utilities 官方提供 C++/Dart/Java/Swift/TypeScript/Kotlin 多语言实现),不依赖任何 CSS 特性;demo 在运行时用 TS 移植版计算并输出 rgb()/hex,任何能显示 CSS 颜色的浏览器都适用。
note.en: HCT is a pure algorithm (material-color-utilities ships official C++/Dart/Java/Swift/TypeScript/Kotlin implementations) with no CSS dependency; the demo computes at runtime with the TS port and outputs rgb()/hex usable in any browser that renders CSS colors.

fallback.zh: 调色板产物就是 hex/rgb 值,建议在构建期生成并落成 CSS 变量(如 --md-sys-color-primary),运行期无需任何兼容性处理;唯一要注意的是 tone 端点的高色度会被截断,生成后应复核实际 hex。
fallback.en: The palette's output is hex/rgb values — generate them at build time into CSS variables (e.g. --md-sys-color-primary) and no runtime compatibility work is needed; the only caveat is chroma clamping at extreme tones, so re-check the actual hex after generation.

use.zh: 从品牌色推导 Material 体系全套色阶:primary/secondary/tertiary/neutral/error 五板共 65 色
use.en: Deriving a full Material scale from a brand color: five palettes (primary/secondary/tertiary/neutral/error) of 65 colors total

use.zh: 任何需要『tone 差 = 对比度差』的体系:tone 差 40 保证对比度≥3:1,差 50 保证≥4.5:1(库文档)
use.en: Any system where tone delta must mean contrast delta: 40 tone difference guarantees ≥3:1 contrast, 50 guarantees ≥4.5:1 (library docs)

use.zh: 亮暗双主题共用一套调色板:只是从 tone 40 列换到 tone 80 列取色
use.en: One palette serving both themes: light reads from tone 40, dark reads from tone 80

use.zh: 数据可视化色阶:等感知步长(color-mix 或手写档位都不如 tone 直接)
use.en: Data-viz ramps: equal perceptual steps — nothing beats tone for directness

avoid.zh: 把 HCT 的 hue/chroma 当 HSL 用——两套刻度不重合,直接搬运会得到完全不同的颜色
avoid.en: Treating HCT's hue/chroma as HSL — the scales differ, so transplanting values produces entirely different colors

avoid.zh: 指望近黑/近白的 tone 保有高色度——sRGB 在 tone 0/100 附近只给灰,这是物理限制而非 bug
avoid.en: Expecting high chroma near tone 0/100 — sRGB only offers gray there; it is physics, not a bug

avoid.zh: 手工在 hex 上『加黑加白』模拟 tone 阶梯——L* 感知均匀性会丢失,档位观感忽大忽小
avoid.en: Simulating tone steps by mixing black/white into hex — L* uniformity is lost and steps feel uneven

a11y.zh: tone 就是 CIE L*,与 WCAG 相对亮度直接挂钩:同列内任取两档,tone 差 40 保证对比度≥3:1(非文本/大字),差 50 保证≥4.5:1(正文 AA)——这是 Hct 类文档明示的库内保证。因此『on-色与色底 tone 差 ≥50』即可满足 AA;但半透明、渐变等场景仍需按实际叠加复核。
a11y.en: Tone is CIE L*, directly tied to WCAG relative luminance: any two steps of one palette with a 40-tone gap guarantee ≥3:1 contrast (non-text/large text), and a 50-tone gap guarantees ≥4.5:1 (body AA) — a guarantee stated in the Hct class docs. Keeping 'on-color vs. base' at ≥50 tone apart therefore satisfies AA; translucent or gradient pairings still need a re-check on the actual composite.

goal.zh: 实现 HCT 色调调色板生成器:输入 hue/chroma,输出 tone 0–100 的 13 档色阶(hex + 每档 tone 值),高亮指定档位并标注 M3 角色档位约定。
goal.en: Implement an HCT tonal-palette generator: given hue/chroma, output the 13-step tone 0–100 ladder (hex + tone per step), highlight the selected step, and annotate M3 role-tone conventions.

acceptance.zh: HCT→sRGB 用 material-color-utilities 的求解算法(CAM16 求解 + 关键平面二分),不引第三方包
acceptance.en: HCT→sRGB uses the material-color-utilities solver (CAM16 solve + critical-plane bisection), no third-party packages

acceptance.zh: tone 阶梯固定 hue/chroma,只动 tone,13 档等 tone 间隔
acceptance.en: The ladder fixes hue/chroma and varies only tone, 13 steps at equal tone intervals

acceptance.zh: 请求色度超过某 tone 可达上限时,如实展示截断后的实际色(chroma 求解器官方行为)
acceptance.en: When requested chroma exceeds a tone's achievable max, show the clamped actual color honestly (official solver behavior)

acceptance.zh: 每档输出 hex 并可核对 tone 值;标注 tone 差 40/50 的对比度保证
acceptance.en: Each step outputs hex with its tone value; annotate the 40/50-tone contrast guarantees

acceptance.zh: 默认 hue 299 / chroma 48 / tone 80 对齐 M3 基线体系
acceptance.en: Defaults hue 299 / chroma 48 / tone 80 align with the M3 baseline system
